hints.content: Each year, the number of visitors to the Eiffel Tower grows by a constant **ratio**, so it is best to use an exponential function.
An exponential function best models this relationship.

question.content:
The number of visitors to the Eiffel Tower in Paris increases by $1.5\%$ each year.

**Which kind of function best models the relationship between time and the number of visitors to the Eiffel Tower?**
